nodes.ownership: Existing three station slabs and reference patch only. No city/art/worker rebuild.

nodes.notes: Source OSM footprint clipped at z68 preserved. Runtime area guard compares all top triangles to polygon shoelace area before assigning mesh. Upward top normals, closed side/bottom mesh.

nodes.variation: Restrained per-tile tone and fine grain; 2F sparse terrazzo flecks. Material choices are not surveyed real finishes. Reference patch uses identical 2F material and world-aligned UV.

nodes.details: All regenerated meshes use MvpMeshPersistence.Store. No CopySerialized and no automatic static batching.
